Builddrone 0.3.1 fixes broken documentation links and improves the
documentation deployment workflow. The archiver example is simplified and
ships with sample archive output.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Documentation

- Corrected the published documentation URL to
  `https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/` in the README, PyPI
  metadata, and installation guide
- Docs deployment now uses mike redirect aliases and sets `latest` as the
  default version so the site root redirects correctly after each release

---

## Examples

- Archiver example setup script refactored to use `pathlib` instead of
  `os.path`
- Added sample `result.zip` and `summary.zip` outputs to `example/archiver`

---
